verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API server (localhost:1337), which in principle lets developers use existing OpenAI-style Python/JS SDKs to call it, but there is no evidence of an official Jan-branded client library for Python or JavaScript, nor documentation/examples showing this usage. Missing for 10: official Jan SDKs/client libraries, developer docs or code samples demonstrating Python/JS integration, and any OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404s).
